symbols.name: chunk width
symbols.meaning: The number of bits in each of the two address chunks.
symbols.quote: Fast address-chunk interchange swaps two disjoint $u$-bit address fields of an array with $V$ entries (volume) in time $O(Vu^\tau)$

symbols.name: volume
symbols.meaning: The number of entries of the array.
symbols.quote: Fast address-chunk interchange swaps two disjoint $u$-bit address fields of an array with $V$ entries (volume) in time $O(Vu^\tau)$

symbols.name: time exponent
symbols.meaning: The fixed exponent below 1 in the time bound, 1-2^{-50}.
symbols.quote: with $\tau=1-2^{-50}$ fixed.

symbols.name: radix
symbols.meaning: The fixed prime used as digit radix.
symbols.quote: With radix-$q$ digits, $q$ a fixed prime, let $H,D$ be the chunk values.

symbols.name: first chunk
symbols.meaning: The value of the first chunk.
symbols.quote: With radix-$q$ digits, $q$ a fixed prime, let $H,D$ be the chunk values.

symbols.name: second chunk
symbols.meaning: The value of the second chunk.
symbols.quote: With radix-$q$ digits, $q$ a fixed prime, let $H,D$ be the chunk values.

symbols.name: chunk digits
symbols.meaning: The number of radix-q digits in each chunk.
symbols.quote: Let chunks have $e=m^k$ digits ($m$ fields, $k$ levels), each field $b=e/m$ digits, so $H,D$ are vectors over $\mathbb Z/q^b\mathbb Z$.

symbols.name: fields per chunk
symbols.meaning: The number of fields each chunk is split into.
symbols.quote: Let chunks have $e=m^k$ digits ($m$ fields, $k$ levels), each field $b=e/m$ digits, so $H,D$ are vectors over $\mathbb Z/q^b\mathbb Z$.

symbols.name: levels
symbols.meaning: The number of recursion levels, with e = m^k.
symbols.quote: Let chunks have $e=m^k$ digits ($m$ fields, $k$ levels), each field $b=e/m$ digits, so $H,D$ are vectors over $\mathbb Z/q^b\mathbb Z$.

symbols.name: field width
symbols.meaning: The number of digits in each field.
symbols.quote: Let chunks have $e=m^k$ digits ($m$ fields, $k$ levels), each field $b=e/m$ digits, so $H,D$ are vectors over $\mathbb Z/q^b\mathbb Z$.

symbols.name: wires
symbols.meaning: The number of wires of the exchange network.
symbols.quote: The [exchange network](exchange-network.md) has $W$ wires and edge matrices $A_\epsilon$ of total rank $s<Wm$

symbols.name: edge matrix
symbols.meaning: The matrix attached to a network edge.
symbols.quote: The [exchange network](exchange-network.md) has $W$ wires and edge matrices $A_\epsilon$ of total rank $s<Wm$

symbols.name: total edge rank
symbols.meaning: The sum of the ranks of the edge matrices.
symbols.quote: The [exchange network](exchange-network.md) has $W$ wires and edge matrices $A_\epsilon$ of total rank $s<Wm$

symbols.name: frame permutation
symbols.meaning: The address permutation moving the entry at (H,D) to (H+MD,D).
symbols.quote: A [frame](array-frames.md) at a vertex with matrix $M$ is the address permutation $\Phi_M$, $(H,D)\mapsto(H+MD,D)$

symbols.name: vertex matrix
symbols.meaning: The matrix attached to a network vertex, determining its frame.
symbols.quote: A [frame](array-frames.md) at a vertex with matrix $M$ is the address permutation $\Phi_M$

symbols.name: wire input
symbols.meaning: The physical input array of wire w.
symbols.quote: $f_w$ is wire $w$'s input, $\sigma(w)$ its role

symbols.name: role assignment
symbols.meaning: The map sending wire w to its role sigma(w).
symbols.quote: $f_w$ is wire $w$'s input, $\sigma(w)$ its role

symbols.name: cost per volume
symbols.meaning: A uniform upper bound on time divided by logical volume at width m^k.
symbols.quote: With $F_k$ the bound on time per unit volume at width $m^k$

symbols.name: high digits
symbols.meaning: The number of top digits of each chunk interchanged first.
symbols.quote: Interchange and join the top $\rho$ digits: the high parts form a row field of range $R=q^{2\rho}\ge W^k$ before both remaining chunks.

symbols.name: row range
symbols.meaning: The range of the row field formed by the two high parts.
symbols.quote: Interchange and join the top $\rho$ digits: the high parts form a row field of range $R=q^{2\rho}\ge W^k$ before both remaining chunks.

symbols.name: piece count
symbols.meaning: The number of pieces of width m^j in the base-m expansion of e minus rho.
symbols.quote: Write $e-\rho=\sum_{j=0}^k a_jm^j$, $0\le a_j<m$, and interchange corresponding pieces ($a_j$ pieces of width $m^j$) by the power-width case.
